title: GCD Acceptance
description: A legal person accepts appointment under a GCD 5.0.0 credential, without qualification, and undertakes the duties whose bearer is the delegate (this.i @8tpzdyl5; Restatement (Third) of Agency §1.01 makes agency a relationship of mutual assent). It is issued after the GCD by the GCD's agent of record, which is the delegate itself when the delegate is a legal person acting for itself, and its issuee is the GCD's issuer. Where the GCD names an agent of record, a verifier denies every act under it until it is shown a matching acceptance, so the agent's assent is a precondition a stranger can check open-loop. It is a separate credential rather than an IPEX admit, because an admit authenticates a key, not a legal person's intent. An acceptance carries nothing that could qualify it: a qualified acceptance is no acceptance.

t.description: Message type. Optional; an ACDC JSON message without it is of type acm.

i.description: AID of the accepting legal person: the agentOfRecord the GCD names

rd.description: Registry SAID. Required: an acceptance is a condition of authority that a verifier checks, so its status must be discoverable the same way the GCD's is.

i.description: AID of the issuee: the issuer of the referenced GCD

dt.description: Issuance datetime, ISO-8601 datetime string. It is later than the referenced GCD's.

capacity.description: The capacity in which the agent of record accepts. agentOfRecord: an agent of record that acts through a delegate other than itself, such as the operator of an AI delegate. delegate: the GCD's delegate, a legal person acting for itself and named as its own agent of record.

gcd.description: The GCD whose appointment this accepts.

o.description: Operator: no issuer-to-issuee constraint, because the acceptor is the GCD's agent of record, which need not be its issuee.

oneOf.const: The issuer of this acceptance accepts, without qualification, appointment under the referenced credential and the rules that credential carries, which were available to it in full before it issued this acceptance, and undertakes as its own the duties whose bearer is the delegate.
